items.source:
Advice invoked before a method is invoked. Such advices cannot
prevent the method call proceeding, unless they throw a Throwable.
items.translation: 在方法调用之前调用的 Advice。除非抛出 Throwable，否则此类 Advice 无法阻止方法调用的继续执行。

items.source: Callback before a given method is invoked.
items.translation: 在调用给定方法之前的回调。

items.source: target - the target of the method invocation. May be null.
items.translation: target - 方法调用的目标。可能为 null。

items.source: Throwable - if this object wishes to abort the call. Any exception thrown will be returned to the caller if it's allowed by the method signature. Otherwise the exception will be wrapped as a runtime exception.
items.translation: `Throwable` - 如果此对象希望中止调用。 如果方法签名允许，则抛出的任何异常都将返回给调用者。否则，该异常将被包装为运行时异常。
